# secopsctl content-hub

Content Hub: browse + install/uninstall marketplace integrations and content packs

## content-hub browse

Content Hub overview: integration + content-pack totals and installed counts

```text
secopsctl content-hub browse
```

## content-hub contentpacks

List Content Hub content packs (read-only); `get <id>` to inspect one

```text
secopsctl content-hub contentpacks
```

## content-hub contentpacks get

Show one Content Hub content pack (read-only)

```text
secopsctl content-hub contentpacks get <identifier>
```

## content-hub diff

Show the diff between installed and marketplace version of an integration

```text
secopsctl content-hub diff <integration-id>
```

## content-hub featured install

MUTATING (guarded): install a featured playbook or block

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
secopsctl content-hub featured install --name <uid> [flags]
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | bool | false | preview only (default behavior) |
| `--env` | string | Default Environment | target environment name |
| `--name` | string | - | featured playbook uid (from `featured list --json`, or the full resource name) |
| `--yes` | bool | false | apply for real / skip confirmation |

## content-hub featured list

List featured playbooks from the Content Hub

```text
secopsctl content-hub featured list
```

## content-hub get

Show one marketplace integration (read-only)

```text
secopsctl content-hub get <identifier>
```

## content-hub install

MUTATING (guarded): install a Content Hub marketplace integration

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
secopsctl content-hub install --identifier <id> [flags]
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | bool | false | preview only (default behavior) |
| `--identifier` | string | - | marketplace integration identifier (from 'soar marketplace list') (required) |
| `--yes` | bool | false | apply for real / skip confirmation |

## content-hub list

List Content Hub marketplace integrations (read-only)

```text
secopsctl content-hub list [--installed] [flags]
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--installed` | bool | false | show only installed integrations |

## content-hub uninstall

MUTATING (guarded): uninstall a Content Hub marketplace integration

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
secopsctl content-hub uninstall --identifier <id> [flags]
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | bool | false | preview only (default behavior) |
| `--identifier` | string | - | installed marketplace integration identifier (required) |
| `--yes` | bool | false | apply for real / skip confirmation |
